kind: independent analytical audit; no new solver or evaluator run

B3_issue.problem: A threshold chosen as the maximum head/tail across all selected operations need not be valid for every selected operation. S must be restricted to one pipe.
B3_issue.counterexample: Local interval: one V-pipe prefix takes 10 cycles and precedes a 1-cycle M operation; another 100-cycle M operation is ready at the interval start. With one core the V prefix overlaps the 100-cycle M operation, followed by the 1-cycle M operation, so the interval is 101 cycles. Taking a=max(heads)=10 and W_M=101 incorrectly yields 111. Taking a<=min(heads)=0 is valid. This is an algebraic counterexample, not an official-evaluator experiment.
B3_issue.repair: For each v in nonempty same-pipe S, compute internal head/tail excluding v and separator endpoints; select a<=min h_i(v), b<=min t_i(v).

B3_recheck.capacity: Each operation fits within [a,x-b]; required cross-core boundary delay further reduces the interval by (tau-a)+ and/or (tau-b)+ only when the retained dependency path guarantees it. Same-pipe nonoverlap bounds total work by total available core-pipe time.
B3_recheck.different_boundary_cores: For z,A,B>=0, (z-A)+ +(z-B)+ <= z +(z-A-B)+. Hence the same-core expression is an upper bound on available capacity also when endpoints differ.
B3_recheck.inverse: For W,c>=0 and integer cycles, min z satisfying W<=z+(K-1)(z-c)+ equals min(W,ceil((W+(K-1)c)/K)).
B3_recheck.atom_bound: Among the longest (r-1)K+1 operations one core receives at least r; even the shortest r among them require the displayed A_K time. Take max with the capacity bound, not sum.
B3_recheck.composition: Only disjoint intervals separated by an ordered dependency chain can be summed; separators counted once; arbitrary overlapping windows only give a maximum.

B4_recheck: Fixed reference runtime and deterministic action/observation semantics, closure, preservation of enabled actions, state updates and observations imply equivalence by finite-word induction. Not a minimality theorem or implemented general compression.
causality_scope: Paired complete-version outcomes show M/D changes, not isolated attribution to communication versus parallelism.
literature: Keep 12 previously verified, actually cited sources. Pro reports supply research leads and audited conditions; do not cite hidden reasoning or present unverified historical experiments as current runs.

final_followup.B3: Added per-operation core mismatch indicators delta_L/delta_R; boundary existence alone does not impose cross-core waiting on same-core operations. Nonnegative integer thresholds.
final_followup.B4: Fixed G,K,q,config, official source and deterministic reference runtime.
